request.title: Gidlion the Colossal has returned
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: a dead wasteland at the end of time under a bruised purple sky. An army of skeletons kneels and raises bony arms in worship before tiny Gideon, whom they have mistaken for their colossal titan god; behind them looms a giant crude stone statue of a green titan. Epic with a comedic undertone. Characters: Gideon: a slight fairy necromancer with large translucent insect wings, pointed ears and dark ragged clothing, faint green necrotic light around his hands.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Gideon. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.

request.alt: An army of kneeling skeletons worships tiny Gideon as their colossal titan god in a dead wasteland.
